meaning:
παρα-κύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁקַף ni., hi. ;]
1. to stoop sideways.
2. to stoop to look: Luk.24:12 (R, txt.), Jhn.20:5, 11, Metaphorical (see Hort, Ja., in l), to look into: before εἰς, Jas.1:25, 1Pe.1:12.†
